 We head to Germany to take on Bayern Munich in the UEFA Champions League on Wednesday, October 21 at 8pm (UK time).
 We've started the league phase with two wins from two and head to the Allianz Arena for a huge clash, which you can listen to live on Arsenal.com or The Arsenal app with Dan Roebuck and Adrian Clarke.
 TNT Sports is the place to watch the action if you're in the UK. If you're tuning in from elsewhere, here are the broadcasters for the rest of the world!
